source: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, Hawaii census tracts
boundaries: U.S. Census Bureau 2023 Cartographic Boundary File, Hawaii census tracts 1:500,000 (cb_2023_15_tract_500k)
note: Choropleth shows tract-level AFN proxies (disability, limited English, no vehicle, age 65+, poverty) and overall SVI percentile. Aggregates only — not an individual AFN registry.
